author: Sandra Cullimore
paragraphs: I always remember Alex when he would come to the hospital to see his doctor. We all adored him. He was always so upbeat and made us laugh. He loved Oreo cookies. We had Oreo cookies in our clinic. We would fill his pockets with cookies every time he came to the clinic. We love the Wernli family. You guys are amazing. I remember being in your home in the theatre watching Alex's favorite show and eating popcorn and having sodas. And THANKS for the homemade oreo cookies that we still get from Linda and have since Alex died. Words cannot express my love for Alex, for the Wernli family and the beautiful memories we still enjoy. All my love, Sandy Cullimore ❤️
